user.title: HappyParking
user.description: Sign in the way you sign in to the HappyParking app. Your parking server, user id and site code are read from the login, so there is nothing to look up.

menu_options.password: Sign in with a HappyParking id and password

kakao.title: Sign in with Kakao
kakao.description:
1. Open this link and complete the normal Kakao login:

{auth_url}

2. You land back on the HappyParking site. Copy the address from your browser's address bar and paste it below.

If the page moves on before you can copy it, paste your login token instead (in the browser: developer tools → Application → Local Storage → `token`).

data.login_result: Address you landed on (or login token)

manual.title: Server details
manual.description: Only needed if signing in does not work.

error.invalid_url: The base URL must start with http:// or https://
error.invalid_login_result: That does not look like the address or token from a HappyParking login.
error.invalid_token: The login token could not be read.
error.login_failed: The login did not succeed. Please try again.
error.kakao_not_registered: That Kakao account is not registered with HappyParking.
error.no_server: The login did not include a parking server address for your building.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the HappyParking service.
